abstract: Five cases of anterior mediastinal tumour are presented. Two cases were asymptomatic, being discovered by routine chest radiography. The remainder presented with dyspnoea, dysphagia and a sinus over the manubrium. Each case provided a lesson in the management of the mediastinal mass. Pathologies included haemangioma, teratoma, secondary carcinoma from the kidney and a malignant thymoma which caused cardiac tamponade. Features of interest in the presentation, treatment and pathology are discussed. It is concluded that a full investigation of mediastinal swellings is needed before mediastinoscopy is performed; that incision of swellings in the base of the neck should be avoided; and it is suggested that the management of asymptomatic mediastinal haemangioma in adults may be expectant.
abstract_ja: 前縦隔腫瘍の5症例を提示する。2例は無症状で、胸部X線の定期検査で発見された。残りは呼吸困難、嚥下困難、胸骨柄上の瘻孔で受診した。各症例は縦隔腫瘤の管理に関する教訓を与えた。病理診断は血管腫、奇形腫、腎臓からの続発性癌、心タンポナーデを起こした悪性胸腺腫であった。縦隔腫瘤では縦隔鏡検査の前に十分な精査が必要であること、頸部腫脹の切開は避けるべきであること、無症状の成人の縦隔血管腫は経過観察が妥当かもしれないことを提案する。症状、治療、病理の興味深い点について論じる。
